name: Greenhouse
description: Greenhouse Recruiting is an applicant-tracking and hiring platform built around Jobs, Offices, Departments, candidates, applications, interviews, and offers.
agentUseSummary: Authorize Relay's Greenhouse partner integration for one exact Recruiting Organization with only harvest:jobs:list, harvest:offices:list, and harvest:departments:list. Agents can list bounded first pages of safe Job, Office, and Department summaries. Relay excludes candidates, applications, interviews, offers, users, hiring-team identities, custom fields, physical locations, writes, raw APIs, broader scopes, and cursor following.

credentialRequirements.label: Greenhouse partner client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Greenhouse-issued Relay partner client ID configured only on Railway.

credentialRequirements.label: Greenhouse partner client secret

credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind the exact mutual-customer Organization before authorization.

capabilities.label: Read Jobs
capabilities.description: List bounded safe Job requisition summaries.

capabilities.label: Read recruiting structure
capabilities.description: List bounded safe Office and Department hierarchy summaries.

approvalRequired.label: List Jobs
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five Jobs from the first Harvest v3 page.

approvalRequired.label: List Offices
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five safe Office hierarchy summaries from the first page.

approvalRequired.label: List Departments
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five Department hierarchy summaries from the first page.

blocked.label: Read candidate data
blocked.description: Candidates, applications, interviews, offers, EEOC/demographics, attachments, notes, emails, scorecards, and approvals are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read sensitive recruiting data
blocked.description: Hiring-team identities, users, descriptions, custom fields, openings, posts, office physical locations/contact users, and reports are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change Greenhouse
blocked.description: Create, update, move, hire, reject, delete, lifecycle, and all other mutations are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use raw Harvest API
blocked.description: Harvest v1/v2, customer client credentials, arbitrary paths, filters, fields, cursors, pagination, raw responses, and broader scopes are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All three bounded recruiting-structure reads require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The three selected reads run without per-action approval while exact scopes, Organization binding, bounds, redaction, refresh, and audit remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts three fixed safe Harvest v3 list wrappers and attaches refreshed partner OAuth tokens server-side.
Relay mounts three fixed safe Harvest v3 list wrappers and attaches refreshed partner OAuth tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: A signed Greenhouse partnership agreement, provider-issued testing/production credentials, exact Railway callback, requested scopes, and authorized staging Organization are required.
providerSetup.nextAction: Complete Greenhouse partner approval for exactly the three list scopes, configure the Railway callback and credentials, then validate Site Admin consent, rotating 24-hour refresh tokens, Organization binding, denial, and the three bounded reads.

evidence.supports: Greenhouse documents partner-only authorization code OAuth, exact callback and scopes, HTTP Basic token exchange, one-hour access tokens, rotating 24-hour refresh tokens, and Site Admin requirements for list endpoints.
Greenhouse distinguishes multi-customer partner OAuth from customer-only client credentials and requires server-side secret storage and Bearer access to Harvest v3.
Greenhouse documents the Harvest v3 Jobs list, per_page bounds, cursor pagination, and Job fields; Relay sends only per_page and never follows a cursor.
Greenhouse documents the Offices list and hierarchy, including physical-location and contact fields Relay discards.
Greenhouse documents the Departments list and safe hierarchy fields used by Relay.
